read.name: firmware_version_1

read.name: protocol_number

read.name: battery_current_legacy
read.description: Battery current (unsigned, no sign for charge/discharge direction). Use battery_current (5631) instead for signed value.
notes: mkaiser reports this may actually be signed (S16) despite the datasheet specifying U16 — see mkaiser issue #304. Use battery_current (5631) which is definitively S16.

read.name: battery_power_legacy
read.description: Battery power (U16 without sign). Data type is S16 for SH3.0-6.0RS and SH8.0-10RS. Use battery_power (5214) instead for S32 with full range.
notes: Firmware behavior changed around October 2024: older firmware always returns a positive value (no charge/discharge direction); newer firmware uses signed S16 (positive = charging, negative = discharging). Use battery_power (5214) for consistent S32 signed value across all firmware versions.

read.name: battery_soc
read.description: Battery state of charge (SOC) as percentage (0-100%).
notes: Returns absolute SOC (0-100%). The battery operates between min_soc and max_soc (hold registers 13059/13058), but this register always shows the full 0-100% range.

read.name: battery_soh

hold.description: Feed-in power limitation enable/disable (0xAA = Enable, 0x55 = Disable).

hold.name: feed_in_limitation_ratio
hold.description: Feed-in limitation as percentage of rated power. Added in protocol V1.1.7. Takes precedence over register 13074 when both set.

hold.name: active_power_limitation
hold.description: Active power limitation enable/disable. Controls inverter AC output port (vs feed-in at grid connection point). Added in V1.1.7. On some SH*T firmware, this register returns 0xFFFF; use active_power_limit_enable (31204) instead.

hold.name: active_power_limit_ratio
hold.description: Active power limitation ratio (0-100%). Controls inverter AC output as percentage of rated power. Added in V1.1.7. On some SH*T firmware, this register returns 0xFFFF; use active_power_limit_percent (31205) instead.

hold.name: reserved_soc_for_backup
hold.description: Minimum reserved SOC for backup (off-grid) operation (0-100%). Battery enters emergency charging when SOC drops below this.

hold.name: active_power_limit_enable
hold.description: Active power limitation enable/disable (iSolarCloud path). When Enabled, caps AC output to the ratio set in active_power_limit_percent (31205). Works on SH*T models where the official-spec register 13089 returns 0xFFFF. Discovered via iSolarCloud reverse-engineering.

hold.name: active_power_limit_percent
hold.description: Active power limitation ratio (iSolarCloud path). Sets maximum AC output as a percentage of rated power (0-100%). Paired with active_power_limit_enable (31204). Active Power Gradient Control causes the change to take effect gradually — allow a few minutes. Note: setting this to 0% while active_power_limit_shutdown_at_zero (31213) is On will shut down the inverter.

hold.name: active_power_limit_shutdown_at_zero
hold.description: When On, the inverter shuts down if the active power limitation ratio (31205) reaches 0%. Set to Off before lowering active_power_limit_percent to 0% to avoid an unintended shutdown.

hold.name: feed_in_limitation_value_wide_range
hold.description: Feed-in limitation value with extended range (0.01kW resolution). Use when value exceeds U16 max of 65.535kW via register 13074.

hold.name: charge_cutoff_voltage_wide_range
hold.description: Battery charge cutoff voltage (wide range). Added V1.1.7.
